images.alt: A black machine gun with a distinctive perforated barrel jacket, a spade grip and a large pan-shaped magazine on top, mounted on a museum stand
images.caption: A Vickers K machine gun on display, showing its perforated barrel jacket and pan magazine.

images.alt: A soldier sits behind a Vickers K machine gun mounted on a truck, with a second gun visible mounted beside him, in a desert setting
images.caption: A Long Range Desert Group patrol member with a Vickers K machine gun mounted on a Chevrolet truck, May 1942, where the gun's light weight and sand-resistant action suited vehicle-mounted use.

credit.author: No 1 Army Film & Photographic Unit, Graham (Lt)
credit.title: File:A member of a Long Range Desert Group (LRDG) patrol poses with a Vickers 'K' Gas-operated machine gun on a Chevrolet 30-cwt truck, May 1942. E12410.jpg

images.alt: A gunner in flying gear operates a Vickers K machine gun from the open rear cockpit of a biplane bomber in flight
images.caption: An RAF air gunner manning a Vickers K in the rear cockpit of a Fairey Battle light bomber, the gun's original intended role.

credit.author: Devon S A (Mr) (Royal Air Force official photographer)
